records.device: Patient Information Center iX, Product Code 866386, and Patient Information Center iX Expand, Product Code 866390, Software Revision 4.0.1
records.reason: During extended operation of the MX40 with the PIC iX, the DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) lease can expire on the MX40.
